text_block_list.text:
A few weeks before the Takarazuka Kinen,
classmates clashed on a different stage as well.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaa~, Grass Wonder!
You're the King of the Spring Mile~~!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
No, no, when it comes to royalty, it's gotta be King Halo!
Two consecutive graded race wins since early spring!
The crown of a GⅠ is what truly suits her!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: These two are from Spe-chan's generation as well, right?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes! Both of them are super strong! They're even running in the upcoming Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, Tsuru-chan, who's been working
so hard, is also scheduled to run in the
Takarazuka Kinen, so we'll be facing off—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...What about Ms. Suzuka?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-san, have you ever felt weird
after a race?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Like, when I actually just wanted to say "Good job" or "That was amazing."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I used to be able to say it. Up until the Kikuka Sho.
Back when my hard work was actually praised.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"And yet, at the Tenno Sho (Spring),
my throat clenched up tight.
...I couldn't say a single word."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: So you're saying Spe-chan was cheering that girl on from the stands?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
N-No, that's not it! I'm talking about what happened after the race!
I ran in the exact same race as her!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...? Is that true?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: —Then isn't it only natural?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan, you can't stand the thought
of letting that girl take the lead, right?

Preparations for the Takarazuka Kinen continue.
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's body has grown capable of
handling longer, more grueling training regimens.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *sigh*...
Doctor, please perform an ultrasound on my legs.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: Yes. Please leave it to me~

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
May I keep working hard for a bit longer today?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much!
Perhaps affected by what happened at the Tenno Sho (Spring), her obsession with victory had only deepened.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Could we add more slope training to next week's menu?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: The home stretch at Hanshin is an uphill slope. Since this race will come down to a battle of late kicks, I think being able to handle the hill is essential.
Working late into the night to defeat their rivals—building strength, discussing, devising strategies. And then—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
Now all that's left is to review all the race footage again...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ah.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
King-chan! Grass-chan!
Are you two heading home right now!?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes... Tsuru-chan also—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Whoops.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Grass-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. There's no problem.
It seems some of the heat of the competition still lingered.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"This is just summer fatigue.
There's nothing to worry about, Tsuru-chan."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Just as I did last summer,
I still wish to defeat all of you.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: How about you, Tsuru-chan?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...I am.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...I'm in the exact same boat.
I'm from the same generation as Grass-chan and King-chan—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Even more than those of you I respect,
I take pride in my own "absolute."
—As your rival, Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And here we are at the Takarazuka Kinen!
The dream showdown the fans have longed for is about to take place!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The ones to watch are surely the Umamusume
who entered the Senior Class this year. Special Week,
Grass Wonder, and—"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Are you prepared, Tsuru-chan?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Bring it on. I won't back down a single step!
Not against Grass-chan, and not against King-chan—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: For Spe-chan too!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Get ready, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...... Let's do our best, Tsuru-chan!
I will, too――

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...I won't lose.
